text: When a visit is cancelled, the reason is kept on the visit and counted in our cancellation reports. A real reason tells us why families cancel.
Maria Rivera called. Maple is feeling better and doesn't need this afternoon's visit.
The one thing to remember: every cancel needs a real reason, and a visit that has started can't be removed.
Remove doesn't delete the visit. It's kept, and marked cancelled.
Scout won't remove it without a reason.
Say who cancelled and why, in a few words.
It's off the calendar, and the reason is saved with the visit.
Scout stops you. This visit has been started. Finish or void it in the chart first.
Holds are different. Removing a hold just asks, Remove Visit, with no reason.

The most common mistakes: a reason like cancel that tells nobody anything, and removing a visit to start over when Reschedule would keep its history. Remember: every cancel needs a real reason, and a visit that has started can't be removed.
